mapper.select: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.SALE_ITEM_ID, r.USER_ID, r.RATING, r.REVIEW_COMMENT, r.CREATED_TIME, r.UPDATED_TIME, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as REVIEWER_NAME, seller.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN sales s ON r.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON r.USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users seller ON s.SELLER_ID = seller.ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.SALE_ITEM_ID, r.USER_ID, r.RATING, r.REVIEW_COMMENT, r.CREATED_TIME, r.UPDATED_TIME, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as REVIEWER_NAME, seller.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN sales s ON r.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON r.USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users seller ON s.SELLER_ID = seller.ID WHERE r.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.SALE_ITEM_ID, r.USER_ID, r.RATING, r.REVIEW_COMMENT, r.CREATED_TIME, r.UPDATED_TIME, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as REVIEWER_NAME, seller.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN sales s ON r.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON r.USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users seller ON s.SELLER_ID = seller.ID WHERE r.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (REVIEW_ID, SALE_ITEM_ID, USER_ID, RATING, REVIEW_COMMENT, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (review_seq.NEXTVAL, #{saleItemId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{reviewComment}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_COMMENT = #{reviewComment}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
